ending.alsoEnds_one: Also ends the agent it opened. Its node and work so far stay on the canvas.
ending.alsoEnds_other: Also ends the {{count}} agents it opened. Their nodes and work so far stay on the canvas.
ending.stopsTask: Ends the agent and cancels the task. The chat that gave it is not told. Its node stays on the canvas.
ending.stopsSubagents: Stops the turn and marks the chat's own sub-agents as stopped.
ending.clears: Stops any running turn and deletes the conversation, attachments and plans. The chat stays.

dialog.stopSubagentsTitle: Stop the turn and its sub-agents?
dialog.removeWorktree_one: Also remove the worktree and its branch
dialog.removeWorktree_other: Also remove the {{count}} worktrees without work and their branches
